rows.scope: Preventable drowning deaths recorded in WSNZ's DrownBase for calendar year 2025, New Zealand, all ages and all activities (craft/boating included: 'Craft' is an activity category with 17 deaths). WSNZ reports since 2016 cover preventable drownings only; older reports also counted road or air accidents, homicide, suicide and deaths of unknown origin, so those are the implied exclusions. notes: Latest New Zealand breakdown by water setting is Water Safety New Zealand's 2025 Drowning Prevention Report, released 19 Feb 2026 (web edition cited; PDF on Dropbox). Status partial: the web edition prints counts in its text for Tidal (14), Rivers (17), Offshore (3) and Inland still (9); for Coast it prints only the male count (27 = 93%, implying about 29 all-sex, an inference not a figure); for Pools and Home it prints no count. Those three missing counts sit in Infogram charts that render client-side and in the PDF, which Dropbox refused to serve; the two settings without numbers are entered as gap rows (grade D, null low/high) so the report's own setting list stays complete, and the reviewer may prefer to drop them. The settings with numbers do not reach 78 and must not be summed. Total: the report prints 78 (data correct as of 19 Feb 2026). WSNZ's Drowning Insights page (Last Updated 12/10/2026) and its World Drowning Prevention Day 2026 page now give 79 as the provisional 2025 count; both are recorded, as separate rows, because the count is revised as coronial findings arrive. The same site gave 2024 as 72 in Jan 2025 while the 2025 report treats 2024 as 74, so the 2024 comparison in australia- or uk- style tables should use the latest printing. Definition: no written definition of 'drowning' or 'preventable' was found on the pages read. WSNZ's drowning-reports index says reports since 2016 'focus on preventable drownings only' and that older reports also included 'road or air accidents, homicide, suicide or deaths of unknown origin', so those are the implied exclusions; the Drowning Insights page calls the 2025 figure 'the provisional number of preventable drownings'. Water transport is inside the count: 'Craft' is an activity category with 17 deaths in 2025, seven of them on craft in tidal environments. Case-finding: DrownBase is built from NZ Police and Coroners Court information, updated quarterly with deaths the coroner finds to be a provisional drowning; figures 'may change as coronial investigations progress'. Taxonomy: the 2025 web edition uses the environment labels Coast, Tidal, Rivers, Offshore, Inland still, Pools, Home, with no 'Other' or 'Unknown' environment shown and no definitions; the Rivers count (17) equals the Craft activity count (17) by coincidence of two different partitions. Not comparable with australia-location-2024-25 (July-June year, different taxonomy) or uk-waid-2024 (accidental, inland/coastal split) without harmonising definitions. No names, contact details or precise positions were recorded; a named blackspot headland in the release was left out. One correction is proposed, to the who-data-gaps note, and only if these rows are merged.
